title: Fuzzing infrastructure: cargo-fuzz and hypothesis for both engines
description: Set up continuous fuzzing. Rust: cargo-fuzz targets for game definition parsing, action validation, state transitions, CEL evaluation. Python: hypothesis strategies for the same entry points. Fuzz targets should cover: JSON deserialization, move generation with random states, phase transitions with random inputs, event log serialization round-trips. CI integration for scheduled fuzz runs.
